rank_math_desc: 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour: Deadvlei, Sesriem Canyon, the Living Desert Tour and Sandwich Harbour by 4x4. From USD 4,500 per adult.
post_content: This 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour loops from Windhoek through the dunes of Sossusvlei and Deadvlei to the Atlantic coast for the Living Desert Tour and Sandwich Harbour.
overview:
This 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour is a guided loop from Windhoek through the Namib Desert to the Atlantic coast, with 1 night in the Sossusvlei area and 2 nights in Swakopmund. It covers Dune 45, Deadvlei, Sesriem Canyon, the Living Desert Tour and a 4x4 trip to Sandwich Harbour. The price starts from USD 4,500 per adult, and it suits photographers and active travellers.

Divulge Adventures runs this trip as the Namibian Desert Dash Tour: a compact sightseeing safari for leisure travellers, not the Desert Dash mountain bike race held each December.

Why choose a 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour?

The tour links Namibia's two most popular desert areas in one short trip. Sossusvlei and Deadvlei give you the red dunes and white clay pans of Namib-Naukluft National Park, while Swakopmund adds the coastal desert, where pale dunes meet the sea at Sandwich Harbour.

Wildlife is a real part of the trip, from gemsbok, springbok and black-backed jackal in the dunes to flamingos at Walvis Bay Lagoon and the small desert creatures of the Living Desert Tour.

  • Photographers: sunrise on the dunes, Deadvlei and Sandwich Harbour.
  • Active travellers: a climb of Big Daddy and 4x4 dune driving.
  • Short stays: desert and coast in 4 days from Windhoek.

What to expect on the 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour

Day 1 starts with a pick-up from the airport or your Windhoek accommodation and a drive south to the desert, with a lunch stop on the way. You reach the Sossusvlei area before sunset for a sundowner drive.

Day 2 is an early start in Namib-Naukluft National Park. You photograph Dune 45, can climb Big Daddy, and visit Deadvlei with its dead camelthorn trees, then Sesriem Canyon. After lunch you drive to the coast over the Gaub and Kuiseb passes, stopping at Walvis Bay Lagoon for flamingos and other water birds, and spend the night in Swakopmund.

Day 3 begins with the 4 to 5-hour Living Desert Tour in Dorob National Park, looking for the desert Little Five, such as the Namaqua chameleon and the sidewinding adder. After lunch a 4x4 dune drive takes you to Sandwich Harbour, a Ramsar wetland where the dunes meet the sea. Day 4 is the drive back to Windhoek, with a possible visit to a shipwreck and the Cape Cross Seal Reserve if your flight times allow.

Is 4 days enough for Sossusvlei and Swakopmund?

Four days is enough to see the highlights of Sossusvlei and Swakopmund, but the days are full and include long drives on gravel roads. If you prefer a slower pace or want to add Etosha's wildlife, ask us to extend the trip. Our best time to visit Namibia guide explains the seasons, and our ultimate Namibia safari guide helps you plan a longer route.

What is included in this Namib Desert and coast tour?

The price includes accommodation on the itinerary (except in Windhoek), a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle, a professional English-speaking guide, breakfast and dinner except in Swakopmund and Windhoek, all activities on the itinerary including the Living Desert Tour and Sandwich Harbour, park entrance fees, water on board, passenger liability insurance and airport transfers.

Not included are flights, visas, health insurance, personal items, tips and gratuities, and meals not listed, such as dinners in Swakopmund. If you only have time for the dunes, see the shorter 3 day Sossusvlei tour from Windhoek, and read why choose a guided Namibia safari.

From USD 4,500 per adult. The final price depends on your travel dates, group size and lodge availability, and we confirm every detail in your written quote.

faq.q: When is the best time for the 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour?
faq.a: The 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour runs all year, and the trip page does not set a season. May to September is cooler for dune climbs, while December to February is hot inland. Swakopmund stays mild year-round, with morning coastal fog, so pack a warm layer for the Living Desert Tour and Sandwich Harbour.

faq.q: What is included in the 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour?
faq.a: The Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour includes accommodation (except in Windhoek), an air-conditioned vehicle, an English-speaking guide, breakfast and dinner except in Swakopmund and Windhoek, all listed activities, park fees, water, passenger liability insurance and airport transfers. Flights, visas, health insurance, tips and personal items are extra.

faq.q: Where do you stay on the 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour?
faq.a: On this Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour you spend 1 night in the Sossusvlei area and 2 nights in Swakopmund. The trip page does not name the lodges, so we confirm each property in your written quote based on availability. Windhoek accommodation before or after the tour is not included.

faq.q: Is the 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour suitable for families?
faq.a: Yes, families can join the 4 day Sossusvlei and Swakopmund tour, and the dune climbs are optional. Children usually enjoy the Living Desert Tour and the 4x4 drive to Sandwich Harbour. The days include long drives, so tell us your children's ages and we will plan stops and pacing to suit them.
